newsitem.title: POLAND: Budimex in talks on PLN 66 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Budimex in talks on PLN 66 mln deal.

text.p: Polish construction company Budimex SA is negotiating terms of an about 66-million-zloty contract to build a waste incinerating facility in Warsaw, the company's spokeswoman said.
Irena Jagielska told Reuters the city of Warsaw and Polish firm System-Eko would finance the project.
"It will be the first incinerator in Warsaw, the contract is worth about 66 million zlotys and we are still negotiating it but I can't reveal any details," she said.
